    • Field Detail

      • RELEASE_LABEL_PREFIX

        static final String RELEASE_LABEL_PREFIX
        Prefix for the release number when added as a label to the released version of a versionable. i.e. composum-release-r3.1.4 . This is added as an additional mark to be able to easily create queries into version store restricted to the contents of one release.
        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • RELEASE_ROOT_PATH

        static final String RELEASE_ROOT_PATH
        The release data is saved below "/var/composum" + content path of the release root + "cpl:releases", e.g. for /content/ist/composum it is in /var/composum/content/ist/composum/cpl:releaseRoot .
        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • PROP_RELEASE_ROOT_HISTORY

        static final String PROP_RELEASE_ROOT_HISTORY
        Saves the path of the release root when it was created on the "cpl:releases". This is currently not used, but reserved for handling of moving a release root in the JCR tree.

      • TYPE_MIX_REPLICATEDVERSIONABLE

        static final String TYPE_MIX_REPLICATEDVERSIONABLE
        Mixin on replicated versionables that allows specifying the property #PROP_REPLICATED_VERSION. We need a mixin since otherwise we could not specify that attribute on things like nt:resource that do not admit additional properties otherwise.
        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • PROP_CHANGE_NUMBER

        static final String PROP_CHANGE_NUMBER
        Property on the release root that is unique to a certain state of the release. Each time the release is updated, this property is updated. Defined in TYPE_MIX_RELEASE_ROOT. This is actually a random UID since currently there is no history of the release states - it's purpose is just to see whether something changed.
        See Also:
        Constant Field Values
